title: Garden Warfare: Mercenary Edition
tagline: TF2 bots in Plants vs Zombies drag. 4v4 KOTH, your GW2 audio, one click.

phases.name: Static VPK
phases.verification: Run mod/build/pack_vpk.ps1 on Windows -> drop .vpk into tf/custom/ -> launch TF2 -> KOTH Harvest loads with PvZ names, bots forced to the right classes

phases.name: GW2 Locator + Extractor
phases.verification: python main.py prints 'GW2 install found at: ...' + writes manifest.json with mode=strings_only; after dropping a license-clean frostbite_dump.exe and re-running with --enable-extraction, one Peashooter line audible in-game

phases.name: Full Audio Pass
phases.verification: sounds.full.json rules >= 100 and every kit has >=5 categories (confirmed: 140 rules, 8 kits x 6-9 categories each)

phases.name: Package + Melty Publish
phases.verification: Local Claude Code: pack_vpk.ps1 -> build.ps1 -> upload to Melty -> inspect_package pass -> validate_recipe pass -> one_click_check pass -> screenshot -> publish

risks.title: Frostbite audio extraction redistribution
risks.mitigation: Shipping v1 in STRINGS-ONLY MODE by default. Helper detects a user-supplied frostbite_dump.exe at runtime; absent that, mod boots with HUD names + stock TF2 audio. No bundled decoder -> no license question.

risks.title: EA Desktop IS manifest format drift (2025 update)
risks.mitigation: locator.py tolerates installPath/InstallPath/installLocation keys and falls through to Origin registry -> Steam -> defaults -> user-prompted folder.

risks.title: one_click_check may flag the helper .exe
risks.mitigation: PyInstaller single-file build; no network calls; manifest-gated single-run (--once). Code-sign on the build machine if a cert is available.

risks.title: No gameplay footage until build runs on Windows
risks.mitigation: Screenshot captured on the Windows build run. Show fallback mode plainly if frostbite_dump isn't provided.

melty_checks_expected.inspect_package: pass - no vanilla files edited in-place (confirmed in mod/hooks.json)
melty_checks_expected.one_click_check: pass - pending R-003 .exe signature on build machine

open_items_before_publish: Publish handle (ask user once at create_mod time)
Frostbite extractor decision: ship strings-only (default, zero legal risk) or supply frostbite_dump.exe (user obtains it themselves)
Playtested tf_bot_* cvars confirmed from one 4v4 KOTH session
